'''August 1999 Lund tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lund, Sweden on 31 August 1999. [[Emil Wallin]] won it. It is known from Erik Hansson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d35">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-10-lund-sweden-990831d35/ lund-sweden-990831], DeckTech (Erik "erikaros" Hansson, 10 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-10-lund-sweden-990831d35/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 31 August 1999
* '''Site:''' Lund, Sweden
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Emil Wallin]]
